description: Close an MPP `tempo:session` payment channel. Pass the channelId surfaced in a prior fetch's paymentInfo together with the same URL you originally fetched. Signs a close credential with the on-chain settled cumulative amount and POSTs it to the server, returning the on-chain settlement transaction hash when available. Use this when you want to finalize a channel rather than leaving it open for the server to settle on its own schedule.

channelId.description: The payment-channel id to close (the `channelId` field from a prior fetch's paymentInfo).

cumulativeAmountRaw.description: Optional override for the cumulative amount the close credential attests to, in raw atomic units (e.g. "12345" = 0.012345 USDC at 6 decimals). Defaults to the on-chain settled amount. Provide this only when the server has accepted vouchers above the on-chain cumulative.

url.description: The endpoint URL the channel was opened against (the same URL passed to the original fetch).

name: sessions_close

cumulativeAmount.description: The cumulative amount (raw atomic units) the channel was settled at

transactionHash.description: Settlement transaction hash, when the server returns one in the Payment-Receipt header

title: Close MPP Session
